research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Systems and methods for improved database functionality and data translation describe receiving data files from various sources, parsing them into cells linked to entities, and applying configurations to build a unified database. This work supports robust data translation and normalization, enabling consistent, centralized data structures. Overall, Aiwyn is researching unified data ingestion, configurable data structuring, and enhanced database translation capabilities.

about_short_description.short_description: Aiwyn is an automation software platform that provides billing and cash flow for accounting firms.

product.name: Aiwyn Payments
product.description: Payment and billing automation for accounting firms, including invoicing, payment reminders, collections workflows, and reconciliation to support faster cash flow.

product.name: Aiwyn Practice
product.description: Practice management software for accounting firms that brings time tracking, billing, project management, and resource planning into a unified workspace.

product.name: Aiwyn Experience
product.description: A client experience portal for accounting firms that supports secure document sharing, engagement letters, client requests, and related interactions in one interface.

product.name: Aiwyn Tax
product.description: Tax software for accounting firms that supports tax preparation, review, filing, and client collaboration, with AI-assisted capabilities included in the workflow.

product.name: Aiwyn Integrations
product.description: Integration capabilities that connect Aiwyn with accounting technology and other systems, enabling data exchange, workflow coordination, and firm-wide operational visibility.
